pull.title: fix(tui): page main chat directly from the live prompt
pull.body:
## What

Route Page Up/Page Down from the live main-chat prompt into the restored transcript scroll view. Preserve drafts, return to the live prompt on Escape or typing, and leave autocomplete and fullscreen overlays in control of their page keys.

## Why

The native-scrolling change removed the main-chat keyboard entry point. The prompt editor swallowed page keys, so keyboard scrolling could not start from the live chat.

## Testing

- 11 focused tests passed across main-chat input routing, transcript scrolling, and bash output viewing.
- Both affected packages passed no-emit type checks; changed TypeScript passed lint and formatting.
- Full `bun check` was not run locally; remote CI is required before merge. Fork CI currently skips test execution but runs checks and builds.
- Changelog intentionally unchanged, per repository policy unless explicitly requested.

---

- [ ] `bun check` passes
- [x] Tested locally
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated with the required attribution (if user-facing; internal issue fixes use issue links, external contributions add the PR link and contributor credit after creation)
